name: DisequalityDispersion.Machine.readBitM_spec
typeText:
∀ {m : DisequalityDispersion.Machine.Mem} {bs : List.{0} Bool},
  DisequalityDispersion.Machine.PState m bs →
    ∀ {q : Nat},
      Eq.{1} (m DisequalityDispersion.Machine.POS) q →
        ∀ (hqN : LT.lt.{0} q (List.length.{0} bs)),
          DisequalityDispersion.Machine.Cmd.Exec DisequalityDispersion.Machine.readBitM m
            (DisequalityDispersion.Machine.Mem.write
              (DisequalityDispersion.Machine.Mem.write m DisequalityDispersion.Machine.PTR
                (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} DisequalityDispersion.Machine.IN 1) q))
              DisequalityDispersion.Machine.BIT
              (DisequalityDispersion.Machine.bitv (GetElem.getElem.{0, 0, 0} bs q hqN)))
            2

source.code:
theorem readBitM_spec {m : Mem} {bs : List Bool} (hs : PState m bs) {q : ℕ} (hq : m POS = q)
    (hqN : q < bs.length) :
    Cmd.Exec readBitM m ((m.write PTR (IN + 1 + q)).write BIT (bitv bs[q])) 2 := by
  have e1 := Exec.add PTR INB POS m
  have e2 := Exec.load BIT PTR (m.write PTR (m INB + m POS))
  rw [hs.inb, hq] at e1 e2
  have hb : (m.write PTR (IN + 1 + q)) ((m.write PTR (IN + 1 + q)) PTR) = bitv bs[q] := by
    rw [Mem.write_same]
    rw [Mem.write_ne _ _ (by simp [IN, PTR]; omega)]
    exact hs.bit q hqN
  rw [hb] at e2
  exact Cmd.Exec.seq e1 e2
